player_prompt.intro:
O kile wa ba Mogodi {player_id} o bapalang papadi ya Checkers e le {color}.
Dira tšhupetšo ya gago ka tsela ya notation ya chess [fileRank fileRank], mohlala '[b2c3]' (leterele ya kolomong a–h, nomoro ya moruleng 0–7).
Melao ya motheo:
  • Hlahla ka diagonal go ya pele ka 1 ge e se na selo.
  • Gapeletša ka go hlompa papiso ya mmotšaneisi.
  • Papiso e fiwa bogosi ge e fihla kwa bophelo bja kgole.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ga go na tsela ya tsamaya e e nepagetšego. Šomiša [a1b2], mohl. [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Mmala o mogweu ga o na masweu. Mmala o mosweu o thabile!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Ba baso ga ba sa na dibetša. Bohubedu bo a fenya!
outcome.no_moves: Sebapadi {player_id} ga se sa na mothaladi o mongwe.
outcome.draw: Moedi wa go retologa o fihlilwe.
